radius_query_center.source: Original manually selected Karlsruhe study center
radius_query_center.used_for: 5 km baseline and 15 km Overpass comparison

notes: A radius around a geocoded city point is not the same as a municipal boundary.
Candidate counts are map objects, job postings, entity records, or notices as labelled; they are not a count of verified companies.
Full HTTP response bodies are present locally but gitignored. Compact metadata and derived result tables are tracked.

nominatim.role: City geocoding and state hint; not company discovery

state_query.assessment: Public shared endpoint timed out; do not repeat as a production statewide query

openstreetmap_overpass_radius.role: Broad map-based company/site discovery with coordinates and optional homepage

bkg_vg250.role: State boundary and point-to-state assignment; not company discovery

arbeitsagentur_jobs_api.role: Active job-demand signal; not a company census or career-site resolver

wikidata_headquarters_radius.role: Supplemental names and homepages; city-level HQ coordinates and non-company entities limit radius precision

wikidata_entity_coordinates.role: More precise entity points than city HQ references, but unfiltered results include non-companies

ted_procurement_winner_city.role: Public-contract winner leads and supplier city fields; multi-winner notices may include non-local co-winners

gleif_lei_api.city_postal_code_and_region_filters: HTTP 400; filter keys rejected as unsupported
gleif_lei_api.role: Legal-entity name/identifier enrichment; no practical city/radius results in this test

mast_r.role: Niche energy-operator/location candidates; full export not downloaded

destatis_genesis.role: State/industry establishment-count denominator; no company rows

google_places_nearby.role: Potential paid circle-search comparison; no billable request made

cordis_eu_project_participants.role: Research-sector organization leads; location and homepage coverage need a separate test

career_homepage_crawl.seed_source: 56 Wikidata entities; 11 deliberately selected for homepage crawl
notes: The 6/11 outcome is a selected sample, not a statistical hit rate.
Unresolved does not mean that a company has no hiring website.
An age-confirmation gate on Moninger /jobs was not treated as verified hiring content.

recommended_location_model.city_radius: Geocode one city point, query local OSM/Places candidates around the point, and filter by explicit great-circle distance.
recommended_location_model.state: Use BKG state polygons plus a local per-state OSM extract; assign source coordinates to the polygon locally.
recommended_location_model.active_hiring: Add Arbeitsagentur postings as a separate signal and retain job-site coordinates independently from employer offices.
recommended_location_model.career_resolution: Fetch employer homepages with robots-aware limits, follow ranked links/sitemaps, record ATS evidence, and parse only supported public feeds.
